description: This file defines a logging utility class 'Log' for managing and printing logs, warnings, errors, and informational messages with color-coded output based on the operating system.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A logging utility class for handling informational, warning, error, and documentation issue messages with color-coded output.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Log object with configuration options and sets color codes based on OS.

methods.name: __Print
methods.description: Internal method to print messages to standard output.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Logs an informational message if enabled.

methods.name: DocIssue
methods.description: Logs a documentation issue message if enabled.

methods.name: Warn
methods.description: Logs a warning message if enabled.

methods.name: WarnLine
methods.description: Logs a warning message associated with a specific line in a file.

methods.name: Print
methods.description: Prints a message to standard output.

methods.name: Dump
methods.description: Outputs all accumulated errors, warnings, and info messages.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: Sets the current file context and logs a processing message.

methods.name: Ellipsis
methods.description: Truncates a string to 32 characters, adding ellipsis.
